Container.Name: trackseerr
Container.Overview:
TrackSeerr is the self-hosted, multi-user music request, discovery, and playlist synchronization suite for your local Plex Media Server, Plexamp, and Lidarr.
Key Features: - Music Discovery & Requests: Browse trending charts and request albums/tracks with family quotas. - Multi-User Plex Home Routing: Share and sync playlists with specific users, kids, or the entire home. - Zero Spotify API Key Required: Built-in scraper allows seamless public Spotify playlist syncing without developer accounts. - 1-Click Bookmarklet & Clipboard Import: Easily import personal Spotify playlists and Liked Songs into Plexamp. - Scalable Lidarr Trickle Automation: Paced background trickle worker automatically monitors missing albums and triggers targeted searches without overloading MusicBrainz. - Beautiful Dark Web UI: Interactive web dashboard on port 5250 with Plex OAuth sign-in.

Config.Name: WebUI & API Port
Config.Description: Web Dashboard and REST API port. Accessible in your browser.

Config.Name: AppData Storage
Config.Description: Persistent directory for the SQLite database, sessions, sync logs, and missing track exports.

Config.Name: Plex Server URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Plex Media Server, using your server's LAN IP and port 32400. IMPORTANT: Do NOT use localhost on bridge networking.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Plex Admin X-Plex-Token. Optional initially if using the Web Dashboard Plex OAuth PIN login, but required for background daemon sync.

Config.Name: Plex Music Library Section
Config.Description: Name of your Plex music library section.

Config.Name: Plex Machine Identifier
Config.Description: Plex server machine identifier for multi-user access pinning. Leave blank to auto-detect.

Config.Name: Plex SSL Verification
Config.Description: Set to 0 if your Plex Media Server uses a self-signed certificate without valid chain.

Config.Name: Lidarr URL
Config.Description: Optional: Base URL to your Lidarr server (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8686) for automated missing track acquisition.

Config.Name: Lidarr API Key
Config.Description: Optional: Lidarr API Key (from Settings > General > Security) for automated missing track acquisition.

Config.Name: Lidarr Auto-Search
Config.Description: Trigger interactive search immediately when queuing missing tracks in Lidarr (1 or 0).

Config.Name: Lidarr Trickle Rate (Seconds)
Config.Description: Delay in seconds between artist lookups during background trickle push to prevent rate limits.

Config.Name: Lidarr Trickle Batch Size
Config.Description: Number of tracks pushed per manual batch or scheduled drip.

Config.Name: Lidarr Auto Trickle
Config.Description: Set to 1 to enable scheduled automated background trickle drips.

Config.Name: Lidarr Auto Trickle Interval (Minutes)
Config.Description: Interval in minutes between automated background trickle runs.

Config.Name: Feed Access Token
Config.Description: Optional: Secret token to protect RSS feeds, plain text lists, and webhook endpoints if exposed to untrusted networks.

Config.Name: Sync Interval (Seconds)
Config.Description: Duration in seconds between automated background sync cycles (default 14400 = 4 hours).

Config.Name: User ID (PUID)
Config.Description: Unraid nobody user ID for file permission compatibility.

Config.Name: Group ID (PGID)
Config.Description: Unraid users group ID for file permission compatibility.

Config.Name: Umask
Config.Description: Standard umask permissions for created files.
